coordinateReference.latitudeType: planetocentric per LOLA RDR SIS; inherited from product family, not declared in detached image label
coordinateReference.pixelRegistration: area pixel; integral line/sample denotes center

display.rangeMethod: Existing processed artifact 1st and 99th percentiles; values outside are clipped for display only.
display.noDataPolicy: Non-finite Float32 values are transparent; finite samples are rendered.

scientificStatus.coverage: The product is a gridded/interpolated GDR; this image does not imply complete observed coverage.

provenance.noDataRule: Non-finite Float32 values are transparent; finite samples are rendered.
provenance.processing: Colorize existing relative-height Float32 samples row-for-row; no resampling, flip, transpose, radius addition, or physical-value modification.

limitations: PNG colors encode relative elevation for visual display only and are not scientific measurements.
The 1st–99th percentile display range clips image colors, not source values.
No independent RDR point comparison has been completed.
The grid is binned/interpolated and its rendered pixels do not establish observation coverage or artifact-free terrain.
No Earth EPSG code or GeoTIFF CRS is assigned; this is a coordinate-addressed PNG display derivative.
